verdict.rationale: Anytype's first-party docs describe Templates as saved, reusable page layouts that form the base for every new Object created afterwards, and custom Types let you model recurring kinds of notes. That covers defining and applying reusable templates. Nothing in the pack shows dynamic variables such as date or title being filled in when a template is applied, which the story explicitly asks for. Missing for 10: template variables/placeholders (date, title) auto-filled on creation, detail on per-Type default template selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
